# iAR ![sticker](https://pacha.dev/LSTS/hexicon.svg)

## Description

Data sets, functions and scripts with examples to implement
autoregressive models for irregularly observed time series. The models
available in this package are the irregular autoregressive (iAR) model
[Eyheramendy et al.(2018)](https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/sty2487), the
complex irregular autoregressive (CiAR) model [Elorrieta et
al.(2019)](https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/201935560) and the
bivariate irregular autoregressive (BiAR) model [Elorrieta et
al.(2021)](https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stab1216).

## Installation

You can install the released version of iAR from Github with:

``` r

remotes::install_github("felipeelorrieta/iAR-package")
```

## Code of Conduct

Please note that the iAR project is released with a [Contributor Code of
Conduct](https://contributor-covenant.org/version/2/0/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.html).
By contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`BiAR()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/BiAR.md)
  : \`BiAR\` Class
- [`CiAR()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/CiAR.md)
  : \`CiAR\` Class
- [`Planets`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/Planets.md)
  : Transit of an extrasolar planet
- [`agn`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/agn.md)
  : Active Galactic Nuclei
- [`clcep`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/clcep.md)
  : Classical Cepheid
- [`cvnovag`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/cvnovag.md)
  : ZTF g-band Cataclysmic Variable/Nova
- [`cvnovar`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/cvnovar.md)
  : ZTF r-band Cataclysmic Variable/Nova
- [`dmcep`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/dmcep.md)
  : Double Mode Cepheid.
- [`dscut`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/dscut.md)
  : Delta Scuti
- [`eb`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/eb.md)
  : Eclipsing Binaries (Beta Lyrae)
- [`fit()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/fit.md)
  : Fitted Values for iAR, CiAR, and BiAR Classes
- [`forecast()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/forecast.md)
  : Forecast for iAR, CiAR, and BiAR Classes
- [`gentime()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/gentime.md)
  : Generating Irregularly spaced times
- [`harmonicfit()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/harmonicfit.md)
  : Harmonic Fit to Time Series
- [`iAR-package`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/iAR-package.md)
  : iAR: Irregularly Observed Autoregressive Models
- [`iAR()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/iAR.md)
  : \`iAR\` Class
- [`interpolation()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/interpolation.md)
  : Interpolation for iAR, CiAR, and BiAR Classes
- [`kalman()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/kalman.md)
  : Maximum Likelihood Estimation of Parameters for iAR, CiAR, and BiAR
  Models using the Kalman Filter
- [`loglik()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/loglik.md)
  : Maximum Likelihood Estimation for iAR Models
- [`multidata()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/multidata.md)
  : Multidata Class
- [`pairingits()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/pairingits.md)
  : Pairing two irregularly observed time series
- [`phase()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/phase.md)
  : Computing phased time series
- [`plot()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/plot.md)
  : Plot Method for unidata Objects
- [`plot_fit()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/plot_fit.md)
  : Plot Fit Method for unidata Objects
- [`plot_forecast()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/plot_forecast.md)
  : Plot Forecast Method for unidata Objects
- [`sim()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/sim.md)
  : Simulate Time Series for Multiple iAR Models
- [`summary()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/summary.md)
  : Summary of iAR package models
- [`unidata()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/unidata.md)
  : Unidata Class
- [`utilities()`](https://felipeelorrieta.github.io/iAR-package/reference/utilities.md)
  : Utilities Class
